MUTATIONS: the grid's largest cell is a million review rows; a grid that stops short of it would never time the size the decision rests on (SPEC-342 R7, A11)
the grid's mean card lengths are 8 and 32; another long mean would time a different history shape than the report names (SPEC-342 R7, A11)
each cell is timed five times and the report reads their median; four runs would move the median the report records (SPEC-342 R7, A11)
each cell takes one untimed warm-up before its timed runs; without it the first timed run would carry the cold start (SPEC-342 R7, A11)
a review-log gap becomes days by dividing by a day's milliseconds; a far other divisor scales every interval the scheduler reads (SPEC-342 R5, A5)
two targets' checksums of one cell may differ by one part in 10,000; a looser bound would accept a wasm replay that computed other states (SPEC-342 R8, A13)
manual and rescheduled review-log entries are not reviews and are dropped; keeping a rescheduled one would replay it as an answer (SPEC-342 R5, A6)
